These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/jobs`

List jobs

Lists the jobs of the repositories deployed in the environment, by repository and then name, or in the order `sort` and `order` ask for; the list is not paged. Needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when the environment or the repository asked for does not exist, and 422 for an unknown `sort` or `order`.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `repository` | query | no | text or null | Only this repository's jobs. |
| `sort` | query | no | text or null | What the list is sorted by: `name`, `status` (the last run's), `last_run` or `next_run`; by repository, then name, when absent. A job without a value comes last. |
| `order` | query | no | text or null | `asc` or `desc`; by default `desc` for `last_run` (the latest first), `asc` for the others. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `JobOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/jobs/{job}`

Show a job

Shows the job with its triggers. Needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when the environment or repository does not exist or no deployed repository declares the job (the message lists the jobs that exist), and 409 when several repositories declare it and none was named.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `job` | path | yes | text | The job's name. |
| `repository` | query | no | text or null | The repository; needed only when several repositories declare the job. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `JobOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `JobOut`

|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |

## `POST /api/v1/environments/{env}/jobs/{job}/runs`

Start a job

Starts a run of the job. Answers 201 with the queued run, or 202 with the waiting start and the run it waits for when the project is busy. A paused job can be started. Needs `RUN` on the environment. Answers 404 when the environment, repository or job does not exist or is not deployed (the message lists the jobs that exist), 409 when there is no run service account in a protected environment or it is inactive, and 422 when the job's selection matches nothing.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `job` | path | yes | text | The job's name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `JobRunRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `repository` | text | yes |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `JobStartOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `202` | The project is busy: the start waits. | `JobStartOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `JobStartOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run` | `RunOut` or null | yes |  |
| `waiting` | `WaitingStartOut` or null | yes |  |

## `POST /api/v1/environments/{env}/jobs/{job}/pause`

## `POST /api/v1/environments/{env}/jobs/{job}/notify-test`

Send a test message to a job's webhook

Queues a test message and answers 202 with a delivery id; a worker sends it, and the delivery shows how it went. Needs `DEPLOY` on the environment; a CI token is always refused. Answers 404 when the environment, repository or job does not exist or is not deployed, and 409 when the job has no usable `notify:` setting in the environment.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `job` | path | yes | text | The job's name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `JobRunRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `repository` | text | yes |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | Successful Response | `NotifyTestOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `NotifyTestOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delivery_id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/notifications/{delivery_id}`

Show one notification delivery

A test has no run, so the right to read a run does not reach it; whoever may test a webhook may read the result. Needs `DEPLOY`, `RUN` or `READ_ENVIRONMENT`; a CI token is always refused. Answers 404 when the delivery does not exist in the environment.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `delivery_id` | path | yes | text (uuid) | The notification delivery's id, as returned when the test was queued. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `DeliveryOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `DeliveryOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `event` | text | yes |  |
| `state` | text | yes |  |
| `attempts` | whole number | yes |  |
| `max_attempts` | whole number | yes |  |
| `last_result` | text or null | yes |  |
| `delivered_at` | text (date-time) or null | yes |  |
| `job` | text | yes |  |
| `repository` | text | yes |  |
| `next_attempt_at` | text (date-time) or null | yes |  |
